description: Shared transition cases. Consumed by tests/domain-lifecycle-contract.test.mjs (service/lifecycle.mjs) and domain/Vitium.Domain.Tests (F#). Both implementations must return the same ok/state/revision or the same error code. Commands use the strict (non-legacy) shape; provenance is required. `cycles` are multi-step sequences: each step's expectedRevision is the current record's revision unless the step sets `expectedRevision`; a step with from:"initial" applies to the cycle's starting record (atomicity checks). `final` lists the submitted attemptIds, candidate revisions and verification outcomes the final history must still contain, in order.
